items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-09
items.q: The interviewee reads a letter addressed to 'Dear Dave Cullen' from 1957, indicating awareness of the person but no personal interaction or relationship described in the text.

ctx.x: Now read Sushant. I'm reading it. I don't want to know them.

This is a letter headed. New Orleans Jazz Club, 2417 Octavia Street, New Orleans 15, Louisiana. October 18, 1957. Mr. David L. Herman, 107 Camp Street, New Orleans 12, Louisiana. Dear Dave Cullen, I read with interest your letter of October 14th relative to your client, Mr. Nicola Riker, and the possibility of an appearance by him and by Mr. Tom P. Brown to present proof and facts supporting their respective claims. Period. New paragraph. Before any plans could be made for such an occasion, comma, it is necessary…
Yeah, I'll read Brown's letter now. His answer to Mr. Clinton.
